resources.string: EnforceDoze is a completely free and open-source app with no ads and I\'ve put a lot of time into making and improving it, with weekly updates to fix bugs and add/improve features. If you like my work, please consider donating in order to motivate me to work harder and produce even more useful apps!
Please reboot your phone for the changes to take effect
EnforceDoze cannot put a setting back
Wi-Fi is still off: turn it on in Quick Settings.
Mobile data is still off: turn it on in Quick Settings.
Some apps are still suspended: open them from Settings › Apps, or give EnforceDoze root again.
